title: Designely Studio — ascii template: a head rendered as animated ASCII art
note: A free website template: a very large human head in left-facing profile rendered as animated ASCII art in vivid lime green with black shading, with two huge bold headlines overlapping it. She dropped it with Save. Her steal: the ASCII portrait as a portrait device — her own self-portrait or pigeon rendered as ASCII glyphs, as a Play piece or an About-page portrait that reacts to the cursor. Honest limit: the template only runs in Designely Studio's editor, so the steal is the effect to rebuild, not the template.
